instruction_changes.deviation: Playable lab guidance left the control choice unspecified, allowing continuous visual parameters to be exposed only through preset buttons.
instruction_changes.evidence: Explicit user follow-up requests sliders where applicable in frontend labs.
instruction_changes.why_instruction: The existing personal-default and taste-selection owners already govern lab controls; a small refinement persists the requested interaction across projects.
instruction_changes.alternative: No change leaves continuous parameters limited to discrete presets. A project-only slider implementation cannot carry the reusable preference; a new procedure or owner would duplicate the lab guidance.

checks.source_boundary: Continuous/numeric visual parameters use sliders with visible values and useful bounds. Categorical choices use buttons/toggles. Existing comparable content, reset and keyboard operation remain intact. Exact project colors and dial finish are excluded.
checks.nearby_case: Categorical theme selection remains suitable for buttons/toggles; numeric parameters may retain presets alongside their sliders.
checks.ownership_purpose: Existing objective, added value and retirement test retained unchanged.

limits: Explicit-preference source check and deployment readback, not a model behavior or natural-trigger evaluation.
